title: Our logo
slide_intent: Teach designers to account for the space a logo will occupy. A compact stack and a horizontal signature have different implications for legibility.
strategic_value: Slack can preserve its symbol and wordmark as a stable pair while using a stacked lockup at larger sizes.
demonstration: The page presents the primary horizontal signature and a stacked version. Pale symbols and shapes around the two specimens indicate the surrounding space.
practical_value: Use the horizontal lockup for most placements and consider the stacked version when the available size supports it.

content_islands.spec: Stack the horizontal and vertical signatures on the right. Use pale reference shapes around the edges so the comparison includes the space around each arrangement.
